summary: Runtime dependency resolved from mutable third-party GitHub ref
details: package.json declares the runtime dependency `libsignal` as `github:tenka-san/libsignal-node` with no commit SHA or tag. On `npm install`, npm fetches whatever the HEAD of that third-party GitHub repository currently contains and executes any lifecycle scripts inside it on the installer's machine, with no version pin and no integrity check. The dependency ships the forked Signal crypto stack that this library's main surface loads, so the unpinned code is both install-time and runtime-reachable. Whoever controls the `tenka-san/libsignal-node` GitHub account can change the fetched content at any time without a release of this package.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
